# Websidy

> Websidy is a Sylvan Lake web design studio helping small and medium-sized businesses across Central Alberta build professional websites and consistent digital presence.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://websidy.ca/): Overview of web design and digital presence services for Central Alberta businesses.
- [Services](https://websidy.ca/services): Custom website design, digital presence packages, hosting, and maintenance.
- [Pricing](https://websidy.ca/pricing): Transparent pricing for websites, hosting, and digital presence services.
- [Portfolio](https://websidy.ca/portfolio): Examples of websites built for Central Alberta businesses.
- [About](https://websidy.ca/about): About Websidy and our approach to web design in Sylvan Lake and Central Alberta.
- [Contact](https://websidy.ca/contact): Request a quote or get in touch about a project.

## Services

- **Website Design & Development**: Custom-coded, responsive, fast, SEO-friendly websites. No page builders or generic templates.
- **Digital Presence & Brand Consistency**: Profile alignment, brand consistency, and optional always-on social presence.
- **Hosting & Maintenance**: Managed hosting, performance checks, and ongoing support.

## Location

Based in Sylvan Lake, Alberta. Serving Central Alberta.

## Client portal

- [Client Portal](https://itflow.websidy.ca/client/): Existing clients can log in for support and account access.
